title: Internal godot script bug
body:
### Tested versions

- Tested on 4.7.beta.4
- Tested on 4.6.3 stable
- Tested on 4.5.stable
- Tested on 4.4.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable (7d41c59c4) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6800 (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21043.10005) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

My project crashes with "internal script error: opcode 20" with GDScript code that should work normally.

Note that adding the line `await get_tree().create_timer(0.5).timeout` in the ready function before the `UserConfig.v` call, the error changes:
```
E 0:00:01:232   user_config.gd:76 @ reload(): Condition ' (ip + 9) > _code_size ' is true. Breaking..:
  <C++ Source>  modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:903 @ call()
  <Stack Trace> user_config.gd:76 @ reload()
                user_config.gd:94 @ load_default_config()
                main.gd:6 @ _ready()
E 0:00:01:232   reload: Internal script error! Opcode: 4 (please report).
  <GDScript Source>user_config.gd:76 @ reload()
  <Stack Trace> user_config.gd:76 @ reload()
                user_config.gd:94 @ load_default_config()
                main.gd:6 @ _ready()
```


Error on 4.6.3.stable and 4.7.beta.4:
```
E 0:00:00:758   user_config.gd:78 @ (): Condition ' !gdscript ' is true. Breaking..:
  <C++ Source>  modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:1363 @ call()
  <Stack Trace> user_config.gd:78 @ ()
                user_config.gd:94 @ @static_initializer()
                main.gd:5 @ _ready()
E 0:00:00:758   user_config.gd:78 @ (): Internal script error! Opcode: 20 (please report).
  <GDScript Source>user_config.gd:78
  <Stack Trace> user_config.gd:78 @ ()
                user_config.gd:94 @ @static_initializer()
                main.gd:5 @ _ready()
```

Error on 4.5.stable:
```
E 0:00:01:090   @static_initializer: Bad address index.
  <GDScript Source>user_config.gd:76 @ @static_initializer()
  <Stack Trace> user_config.gd:76 @ @static_initializer()
                user_config.gd:94 @ ()
                main.gd:5 @ _ready()
```

On 4.4.stable, the project silently crashes with no messages in the debugger.

### Steps to reproduce

MRP attached, run the main scene.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28433891/MRP.zip)
